blocks.headline: Food brings us together
blocks.tagline: We envision in the greater Woodburn area, a welcoming, warm, and thriving, community where all neighbors, especially those working in agriculture, come together to form friendships while supporting and celebrating one another’s lives.

items.title: Mission
items.text: We are committed to bringing together agricultural workers and their neighbors in Woodburn to foster relationships that strengthen community ties.

items.title: What We Do
items.text:
Engage with our Neighbors

Volunteer and leadership development for youth and adult

Work together to plan, prepare for and clean up events

Share common goals

Share meals and cultural expression

Culturally significant celebrations with food, dance, and music

Listening sessions
